issue.standard_remedy: Route off-contract buying to contracted suppliers
issue.summary: 66% of category spend is off contract

plan.diagnosis: Printed circuit assemblies category shows 66% maverick spend ($9,709,433 of $14,757,228 total spend) across 9 plants, indicating lack of contract enforcement and decentralized procurement behavior. As a direct material category, this fragmentation creates price variance risk, quality inconsistency, and lost volume leverage with contracted suppliers.

remedy_steps.step: Conduct immediate audit across all 4 ERPs (SAP, Oracle EBS, Dynamics 365, NetSuite) and Coupa to identify all non-contracted suppliers receiving printed circuit assembly spend and quantify purchase order volume by plant
Issue procurement policy directive to all 9 plants mandating use of contracted suppliers only, with exceptions requiring VP Procurement approval; communicate contracted supplier list and pricing

Implement system controls: add source list entries for contracted suppliers with indicator '1' (preferred) in SAP (ME01), create supplier restrictions in Oracle EBS Purchasing, configure catalog punchout in Coupa for contracted suppliers, and block PO creation for non-contracted suppliers in this category
Negotiate volume commitment with contracted suppliers based on redirecting $9,709,433 maverick spend to capture 8-12% additional discount on consolidated volume
Establish monthly compliance dashboard tracking on-contract spend percentage by plant and ERP system, with plant procurement managers accountable for 95% compliance target

plan.expected_impact: Redirecting $9,709,433 maverick spend to contracted suppliers and capturing an estimated 10% volume discount will yield $970,943 in annual savings.
kpis: On-contract spend % for printed circuit assemblies (target: 95% within 90 days)
Number of active suppliers in category (target: reduce by 60%)
Average unit price variance vs. contracted rates (target: <3%)
Realized savings from volume consolidation (target: $970,943 annually)
risks: Contracted suppliers may lack capacity to absorb $9.7M demand shift immediately, causing delivery delays
Plant resistance due to existing relationships or technical qualification concerns with non-contracted suppliers
Multi-ERP environment complexity may delay system control implementation and create enforcement gaps
Quality or specification mismatches if maverick suppliers were selected for technical reasons not documented in contracts
erp_actions: SAP: Create source list entries (ME01) for contracted suppliers with exclusive indicator for printed circuit assemblies material group; set posting block in LFM1 for non-contracted vendors in this category
SAP: Configure release strategy (ME28) requiring VP approval for any requisitions outside source list for this material group
Oracle EBS: Add approved supplier list rules in Purchasing module restricting printed circuit assemblies category to contracted suppliers only
Dynamics 365: Update procurement categories with preferred vendor assignments and configure approval workflow for off-list purchases
NetSuite: Create item-supplier restrictions linking printed circuit assembly items to contracted vendors only in vendor records
Coupa: Enable catalog punchout for contracted suppliers, configure policy rules to block or flag requisitions for non-contracted suppliers in this category, set up approval chains for exceptions
